Obviously we do need a nice design this time:
https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/921

What I am thinking about is the examples section:
It was ok while the framework only had a limited set of examples, but at this point a list view no longer feels sufficient.

I think each example should get an introduction page.

E.g.:
Intro: "This is the calendar demo. Special about it are the infinite scrolling views (week, month year) as well as the state management => all inactive views get removed from the real dom, but the JS instances and vdom persist. You can still edit their state inside the settings section".

Here is a link to the related blog post.

Here is a video to see it in action.

Thoughts?
